To have a long-lasting and efficiently working air conditioning, HVAC system, or any cooling or heating system, you need to ensure that it goes through regular maintenance. If HVAC systems maintenance is not on your list, we can help you change that. We have certified technicians who will visit your home to conduct regular maintenance. Our services include regular inspection, changing of filters, cleaning, and others that ensure the proper operation of your HVAC system. Our experts will spot the trouble before it becomes a bigger issue.



By ensuring that your systems have regular maintenance by a professional will ensure that they have a long life. It also saves you from the trouble, stress, and costs associated with delaying the repair or maintenance. 




Maintenance and installation - Essex Air conditioning



In Essex NJ, having proper air conditioning is extremely important. You start to feel the heat in March that doesn’t end until late September. That is why you need the reliable and efficient maintenance and repair services of Lincoln Mechanical . If you think that your air conditioner cannot be repaired, we can help you select the right AC unit for your home and even conduct an installation. In case you are interested in other heating or cooling equipment, we can help you with that as well. 





Save money




Regardless of whether you are a business owner in Essex Air Conditioning or just a resident, you must be aware that the major portion of the bills comes from utilities. Inefficient refrigerator or malfunctioning cooling and heating systems can not only lead to unnecessary hassles but also cost you a lot of money. But, if you use one of our services for regular maintenance, you can drop your cooling and heating costs significantly. These regular services will prolong the life of your systems as well. 



For your HVAC system’s maintenance, you need a team that you can trust. At Lincoln Mechanical, we have licensed professionals who have extensive experience dealing with cooling and heating systems of all types. You can be confident about the work that we will do and rest assured knowing that we will get the job done in just one try. If your AC units need repair or maintenance, you can give us a call and ensure that your house is comfortable.




Give us a call




Whether it is hot or cold outside, you want to create a comfortable environment for yourself and your family inside your home. To do this, you need help from professionals. Contact Lincoln Mechanical  to know more about the services that we offer.

jsonLd.name: Lincoln Mechanical Corporation
jsonLd.description: Lincoln Mechanical Corporation, located in Montclair, NJ, is your premier choice for top-notch air conditioning and heating solutions. For over 40 years, we've been serving Northern New Jersey, including Essex and Morris County, as a full-service HVAC contractor. Our expertise includes ac repair, air conditioning installation, heating and cooling, and furnace repair, ensuring comfort and efficiency in both residential and commercial properties. As an HVAC contractor, we specialize in air conditioner maintenance and repair, HVAC repair, and offer 24/7 emergency services. Trust us for all your HVAC needs, from ac installation to comprehensive system assessments. Contact us today!

review.reviewBody: I called Lincoln Mechanical when my AC stopped working and was impressed by the honest and professional service. I was further impressed by the way the entire team handled a complicated situation: Jim, the owner, Ashley from operations, and Colton from the installation team were all incredibly professional and patiently guided us along, ultimately helping us make the best decision to replicate an older, problematic mini-split system. The technician arrived on time, explained the problem clearly, and completed the repair quickly and affordably. I felt confident that the work was reliable and the price was fair. I would definitely recommend them to anyone looking for an air conditioning contractor or HVAC repair.

A friend recommended Lincoln and I'm glad I called.  Estimate was quick and straight forward - no up-selling and addressed all my questions.  I received a quote that I thought was fair and scheduled work.

They arrived on time, put tarps down, and started work.  They ran into a constraint with my basement after starting (not their fault) and were able to explain everything and provide options. Everything was completed with precision and I was really happy with the results.  They were easy to communicate with and I really appreciated that.

I’ve worked with a few hvac companies at this point and Lincoln Mechanical has been the best. Angelo always is happy to assist with knowledge and education around the system, as well as doing a thorough servicing. The woman in the office is always kind and
Accommodating. And their pricing is very fair. Definitely call these guys!
